message.content: {"caption":"Boxed prompt outlining rules for inspecting a chronological SQLite transcript and keeping memory updates auditable.","description":"A light-gray rectangular text box with a blue border contains the teal heading “Prompt 2: SQLite transcript-mode addendum.” The paragraph says the transcript is stored as one chronological SQLite turns table, directs use of conversation_manifest and read-only conversation_sql_query to decide how to inspect it, and says not to assume the transcript is divided into pages or silently scan it for missing facts. It also requires memory changes to cite inspected turn ranges and cautions against claiming coverage of uninspected rows.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
